newsitem.title: CANADA: Mosaic acquires U.K. sales service company.
newsitem.headline: Mosaic acquires U.K. sales service company.

text.p: Mosaic Group Inc said on Monday it agreed to acquire all the shares of England-based Field Marketing and Consultancy Group Ltd for about C$20 million.
Mosaic chairman Mike Preston said Mosaic revenues are expected to double in 1997 as a result of the merger.
The deal is expected to close by December 31, 1996.
Mosaic said C$5 million of the price will be paid in cash and the balance by the issuance of common shares of Mosaic valued at a price of C$1.40 per share.
Further consideration of up to about C$1.4 million will be paid if Field Marketing reaches mutually agreed upon profit targets in 1997, Mosaic said.
Field Marketing, whose clients include British Airways, Cadbury and Kodak, had 1995 revenues of about C$32 million.
